attachments.title: Virtual Reality workshop with Ken Perlin : design a new museum experience
attachments.text: We invite you for a VR/Holojam workshop with Ken Perlin, professor at New York University and compputer graphics guru, where you can explore different possibilities in VR. We will prototype VR / AR content for augmented reality conferences that will be shown at the holomath museum, directed by Cédric Villani, Director of the Poincaré Institute and Fields medalist. The idea is to create next gen augmented reality museum, where you can learn science by manipulating parameters, equations and graphs in augmented reality. This workshop is for you : if you are interested in the potential of VR for education if...
